identity.notes: Official site identifies Beteseb Restaurant at 8201 Georgia Avenue, Silver Spring, MD 20910. No other Beteseb location was merged.

sources.excerpt: Official homepage identifies Beteseb Restaurant and Silver Spring address.

Official about/menu page identifies 8201 Georgia Ave and states meals are served with injera made of either wheat or teff; imported teff injera is described as gluten-free. This is not item-complete allergen disclosure.
Official current Lunch & Dinner and Breakfast menu surface; item descriptions and category navigation are accessible.
Official online-ordering surface names the Silver Spring pickup address and exposes Vegan & Vegetarian, Beef & Chicken, House Special, Half & Half Combo, and Breakfast sections.
Restaurant-linked vendor search surface identifies 8201 Georgia Ave and current menu categories; descriptions are incomplete for allergen adjudication.
Targeted search found official menu/about/order pages and a third-party menu PDF, but no official allergen matrix or complete ingredient document.

sourceAttempts.notes: Inspected official homepage, about/menu, lunch-dinner, breakfast, and online-ordering navigation.
Restaurant-linked vendor surface identified by official online-ordering/search context; current catalog descriptions are incomplete for allergen proof.
Official ordering surface accessible; no allergen matrix or complete ingredient text.
Search completed for allergen, allergy, nutrition, ingredients, and PDF terms; no official matrix found.
